basic_info.description:
3761 21st Street

Located in Noe Valley/ Liberty Hill, 3 Bedroom, 2.5 Bath Single Family Home.

Upon entry there is a full bathroom to the left with spa-like tub.

Upstairs you arrive at the main living level. There are beautiful hardwood floors throughout this level.

The Living room has period detailing including a decorative fireplace and custom molding plus it has an urban view. There is a formal Dining room with French doors that open out to the backyard area. The Kitchen also has access to the backyard via French doors. A half bath is on this level.

On the third level are the bedrooms. There is a Master Bedroom with Juliet Balcony that overlooks the yard and a wood burning stove. There are two guest bedrooms with ample closets and hardwood floors, one has a private balcony.

The backyard has a wooden deck, brick patio and some mature trees.
There is parking for 2 cars in the private garage.

For a showing of this Wonderful Home call Rob Orlando, Skybox Realty, 415-297-1257.

One Year.

All Utilities paid for by tenant

Owner pays for gardener.
